note: Both sets cover the same core claims and each contains one redundant near-duplicate (A repeats the generator-torque negative-damping claim, B repeats the second-order response claim), so neither is penalized for invention or misbinding. B is more faithful on conditions: it retains the 'active pitch-to-feather wind turbine' context for the derivative/proportional/integral term effects, which A drops, while keeping the positive-gains and Region 3 conditions. A's quotes are marginally fuller (e.g., 'Ref. [10] recommends...'), but this does not offset B's better condition coverage.
